response.sql: SELECT AVG(media_avg) AS avg_of_media_avgs FROM (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_avg FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name);

assumptions.assumption: The engine is SQLite, so CAST(... AS REAL) is needed to avoid integer division in Bytes / Milliseconds.
Milliseconds is never 0. If it were, SQLite would return NULL for that track's ratio and AVG would skip it.
Media types are grouped by MediaType.Name, as the request says 'by name', and each per-track ratio is averaged within its media type before the final simple average.

alternatives.interpretation: Per media type, take the ratio of total bytes to total milliseconds across its qualifying tracks (a weighted ratio), then average those ratios across media types.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_of_media_ratios FROM (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name);
